name: Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU)
summary: Norway's university of science and technology, based in Trondheim; every bachelor's is taught in Norwegian, and English starts at master's level.

ib.text: Study in Norwegian if you have Danish, Norwegian or Swedish A (SL or HL), or Norwegian B HL, at grade 3 or better: that documents Norwegian, and you apply through Samordna opptak.

notes: NTNU says it offers no bachelor's degrees taught in English, and you must prove Norwegian when you apply: you cannot learn it after arriving.
NTNU also exempts Danish, Finnish, Icelandic and Swedish applicants who graduated from upper secondary school in those countries from proving Norwegian.
NTNU offers no scholarships or financial support to undergraduate students.

sources.title: Samordna opptak — Søk med utdanning fra IB (Danish A covers the Norwegian requirement)
